verses.restored: Lord, thou hast been favourable to thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

familiar.text: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

modern.text: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שבות יַעֲקֹֽב

verses.restored: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

familiar.text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

modern.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

original.text: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

familiar.text: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

modern.text: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

original.text: אָסַ֥פְתָּ כָל עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

familiar.text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

modern.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

original.text: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ

verses.restored: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

familiar.text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

modern.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

original.text: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר

verses.restored: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

familiar.text: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

modern.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

original.text: הֲֽלֹא אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָֽךְ

verses.restored: Show us thy mercy, O YHWH, and grant us thy salvation.

familiar.text: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

modern.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

original.text: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ

verses.restored: I will hear what God YHWH will speak: for he will speak peace to his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

familiar.text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

modern.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

original.text: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה

verses.restored: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

familiar.text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

modern.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

original.text: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ

verses.restored: Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss.

familiar.text: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

notes.title: Hesed and emet
notes.body: The line pairs hesed (steadfast/covenant love), emet (faithfulness/truth), righteousness, and peace in poetic personification.

modern.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

original.text: חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ

verses.restored: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

familiar.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

modern.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

original.text: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף

verses.restored: Yea, YHWH shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

familiar.text: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

modern.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

original.text: גַּם יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ

verses.restored: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

familiar.text: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

modern.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.

original.text: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו
